verdict.rationale: The docs describe Parse as a layout-aware agentic parser that turns complex layouts into clean, LLM-ready markdown or JSON. That implies structure is preserved, and one community user said it handled a complex layout better than open-source parsers. However, no evidence explicitly documents heading levels, section hierarchy, or reading-order handling, and one user found table output not in tabular form. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading/section hierarchy in output, documented reading-order handling for multi-column layouts, independent hands-on corroboration of hierarchy preservation.
